    name: "tf-example",
    type: "HTTP",

            originGroupId: "og-3pfz5626nmbb",

    ],

        interval: 30,
        timeout: 5,
        healthThreshold: 3,
        criticalThreshold: 2,
    },
    steeringPolicy: "Pritory",
    failoverPolicy: "OtherOriginGroup",
});

            title="Optional">
        <span id="failoverpolicy_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#failoverpolicy_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Failover<wbr>Policy</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Retry policy on request failure. Valid values: <code>OtherOriginGroup</code> (retry next priority origin group); <code>OtherRecordInOriginGroup</code> (retry another origin in the same group). Default: <code>OtherRecordInOriginGroup</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="healthchecker_csharp">

</span>

    </dt>
    <dd>Health check policy. If not set, health check is disabled by default.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="name_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Name</a>
</span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Traffic steering policy between origin groups. Valid value: <code>Pritory</code> (failover by priority). Default: <code>Pritory</code>.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

## Import



TEO load balancer can be imported using the zoneId#instanceId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/loadBalancer:LoadBalancer example zone-3fkff38fyw8s#lb-3pfzdob8hh3d
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
